title: A pinned defender does not protect the chased cannon
rationale: Differential partner of mx-chs-002: the only addition is the white rook on e1, which pins the black chariot on e5 against its king on e7. The pinned chariot cannot legally recapture on a5 or b5, so it does not protect, the chased cannon is unprotected at every step of the shuttle, and the chasing side (Red) loses at the third occurrence.
